whyThisMatters:
ASO dashboard for iOS App Store and Google Play: keyword research (popularity and difficulty), daily rank tracking, competitor and keyword-gap analysis, review monitoring, app revenue estimates. From 25 dollars a month for up to 10 apps, both stores, full history. ~202 estimated users. Founded Mar 2026, Slovakia. 184 active subscriptions.

Rank tracking is a habit product — devs check it daily and keep paying. Cheap entry price for indies, priced under the AppTweak/Sensor Tower tier. Went from 0 dollars to 4k dollars in about six months.

You add the apps you ship. It watches the keywords, the rank, the reviews, and the competing apps, on both phone stores. The entry plan covers a small set of apps and the history. The company is in Slovakia and only started in 2026. The subscription count is already larger than the founder’s user estimate, so I am not treating those as the same number.
